title: 第十一章 功成 上

content_zh:
林新脑子里几乎是一片空白，眼睁睁看着长耳虎直接朝他扑来，身体却来不及反应。只能全力紧握住手中长剑。
剑身如同枯枝一样折断了，他整个人猛地被侧面一股大力撞到一边。
“师兄快走！！”
安颖的声音这才传来。
是她一脚狠狠将林新踹开，自己则是被长耳虎狠狠抓到右腿，身体被巨大的力量翻滚着在地上滚出一大截。
“安颖！”林新从地上爬起来大叫。
“别管我！你先走，我没事！”安颖迅速一个弹跳从地上起身，手里剑刃唰的一下刺向长耳虎双眼。
林新也知道自己是个拖累，现在最好的做法就是脱离长耳虎的狩猎范围。
长耳虎一声怒吼，扑向安颖，被她敏锐的躲到一边，但因为腿伤，安颖动作很是持盾，只差一点点就无法避开，看起来惊险无比。
一人一虎在林子里的几颗大树周围绕来绕去，左躲右闪。
“该死！”林新心头暗恨自己大意了，轻视了长耳虎。但现在没法，他迅速朝着远处跑去，只要他先脱身，安颖要想脱身就容易许多。
他急速往前奔跑，前面密林越发阴暗，四周到处都是高高的不知名树木，阳光也无法透射过大量树叶，照落进来。
身后的虎啸声越来越远。
林新感觉手腕有点疼，显然是刚才剑断时被扭到了，但现在也顾不得这么多，他迅速抛出一段距离，直到身后几乎听不到声音了，这才停下。
“得找个大树爬上去。否则万一长耳虎追过来就麻烦了！”
四处扫视着可以方便攀爬的大树，林新努力平复着急促的呼***神集中。
林子里一片幽静，没有任何声音，只有偶尔风吹动树叶发出的哗哗。
林新回头望了眼，自己来时的方向和周围的环境没什么区别，地上是厚厚的落叶，连脚印也看不到。
一眼望去，透过树木缝隙可以看到远处弥漫着淡淡的白雾。
而周围的树大多都是高而笔直，基本没有可供攀爬的类型。

“这里....”林新担心师妹安颖，迅速又朝着林子树木更多的方向走去，试图找到一颗方便攀爬的树木。
他不知道自己跑到什么地方来了，但是这地方不知道怎么的，总让他感觉有点发毛。
独自一人站在林子中央，树木有些发黑，远处到处是白色迷雾，没有阳光，给人一种莫名的苍白感。
一颗颗树木就像无数根纤细的黑线，从地上拔地而起，直冲上方。
树林上空隐隐有种淡淡的蓝色，上方的光线也逐渐暗淡下来。
林新一个人走在林子里，他已经感觉有些不对了，周围不光是听不到任何声音，甚至连风也仿佛停顿下来。
眼睛能够看到的距离越来越短，地面上的草丛植物也变得幽黑一团。
嚓，嚓...嚓....
他双脚不断踩在地面枯叶上，发出清脆显眼的声响。仿佛就是这林子里唯一的声音。
忽然，前面隐隐传来一点点细微的声音。似乎是人声！
林新心头一振，加快脚步朝着声音方向走去。
随着距离逐渐接近，声音也越来越清晰。
呜呜...呜呜...
似乎是一个女人的哭声。
脚步微微一顿，林新顿时再度加快速度，这种地方有人哭泣，估计不是落难迷路了，就是受伤了。他身上还有些伤药，或许能帮到对方。到时候也能问问对方这片山林的情况。
向前走出一段距离，前面迷雾逐渐散开。
林新隐隐约约看到前方一个白衣服的女人正跪在地上，双手捂着脸，背对着他哭泣着。
那哭声幽幽的，仿佛十分痛苦，悲怯。
由于女人是背对着他，所以看不清她的面貌，林新试图走近几步，正要张口。
忽然他隐隐感觉不对，心头有些发毛。

那女人身上的衣服，太白了.....太干净了！
“如果是迷路或者受伤落难的人，身上衣服不会这么白净整洁....”林新心头闪过疑点，再看看周围的环境，顿时更是有些毛骨悚然起来。
他原本前进的脚步顿时停了下来。
忽然他脚下似乎踩到了什么很脆的枯枝，发出明显的一声脆响。
而就在这时，那女人的哭声也居然停了下来。耸动的肩膀也微微一停。
“糟！”林新头皮发麻，一动也不敢动。
那女人一动不动，似乎在听声音，等了一小会儿，没有发现什么，她又开始低声的哭泣起来。

content_en:
Lin Xin's mind was almost blank as he watched the long-eared tiger rush towards him, but his body had no time to react. He could only hold the sword in his hand tightly with all his strength.
The sword broke like a dead branch, and his whole body was suddenly knocked aside by a strong force from the side.
"Brother, leave quickly!!"
Only then did An Ying's voice come.
It was she who kicked Lin Xin away hard, while she was caught on the right leg by the long-eared tiger, and her body was rolled by the huge force and rolled out to a large extent on the ground.
"An Ying!" Lin Xin got up from the ground and shouted.
"Leave me alone! You go first, I'm fine!" An Ying quickly jumped up from the ground and stabbed the long-eared tiger's eyes with the sword blade in her hand.
Lin Xin also knew that he was a drag, and the best thing to do now was to get out of the hunting range of the long-eared tiger.
The long-eared tiger roared and pounced on An Ying, but she ducked aside quickly. However, because of her leg injury, An Ying moved like a shield, and was only a little bit unable to avoid it. It looked extremely thrilling.
One man and one tiger were circling around several big trees in the forest, dodging left and right.
"Damn it!" Lin Xin secretly hated himself for being careless and despising the long-eared tiger. But there was nothing he could do now. He quickly ran away. As long as he escaped first, it would be much easier for An Ying to escape.
He ran forward quickly, and the dense forest in front became darker and darker. There were tall unknown trees everywhere, and the sunlight could not penetrate through the large number of leaves and shine in.
The roar of the tiger behind him became more and more distant.
Lin Xin felt a little pain in his wrist. It was obviously twisted when the sword was broken just now, but he didn't care about it now. He quickly threw it a distance and didn't stop until there was almost no sound behind him.
"You have to find a big tree to climb up. Otherwise, if a long-eared tiger chases you, you will be in trouble!"
Looking around for big trees that could be easily climbed, Lin Xin tried hard to calm down his rapid breathing and concentrate.
The forest was quiet, without any sound, except for the occasional rustle of leaves in the wind.
Lin Xin looked back and saw that the direction he came from was no different from the surrounding environment. The ground was covered with thick fallen leaves, and not even footprints could be seen.
At a glance, you can see a faint white mist in the distance through the gaps in the trees.
Most of the surrounding trees are tall and straight, and there are basically no types for climbing.
"Here..." Lin Xin was worried about his junior sister An Ying, and quickly walked toward more trees in the forest, trying to find a tree that was easy to climb.
He didn't know where he had run to, but for some reason this place always made him feel a little hairy.
Standing alone in the middle of the forest, the trees are a little black, and there is white mist everywhere in the distance. There is no sunlight, giving people an inexplicable pale feeling.
The trees are like countless slender black lines, rising from the ground and shooting straight upward.
There was a faint blue color in the sky above the woods, and the light above gradually dimmed.
Lin Xin was walking alone in the woods. He already felt that something was wrong. Not only could he not hear any sound around him, but even the wind seemed to have stopped.
The distance that the eyes can see is getting shorter and shorter, and the grass and plants on the ground have become dark.
Thump, thump...thump....
His feet kept stepping on the dead leaves on the ground, making clear and conspicuous sounds. It seemed to be the only sound in the forest.
Suddenly, there was a faint sound coming from the front. It seems to be a human voice!
Lin Xin's heart was lifted, and he quickened his pace and walked in the direction of the sound.
As the distance gets closer, the sound becomes clearer and clearer.
Wuwu...wuwu...
It seemed to be a woman crying.
After a slight pause in his steps, Lin Xin immediately speeded up again. If someone was crying in a place like this, they were probably lost or injured. He also has some wound medicine on him, which may be able to help the other party. At that time, you can also ask the other party about the situation of this mountain forest.
Walk a certain distance forward, beforeThe fog gradually dispersed.
Lin Xin vaguely saw a woman in white clothes kneeling on the ground in front of her, covering her face with her hands, crying with her back to him.
The cry was faint, as if it was very painful and timid.
Since the woman's back was turned to him, he couldn't see her face clearly. Lin Xin tried to take a few steps closer and was about to open his mouth.
Suddenly, he felt something was wrong and felt a little nervous.
The clothes on that woman were too white...and too clean!
"If you were someone who was lost or injured, your clothes wouldn't be so white and neat..." Suspicion flashed through Lin Xin's mind, and when he looked at the surrounding environment, he suddenly became even more horrified.
His forward steps suddenly stopped.
Suddenly, he seemed to have stepped on some brittle dead branch, making an obvious crunching sound.
At this moment, the woman's crying stopped. The shrugged shoulders also stopped slightly.
"Oops!" Lin Xin's scalp was numb and he didn't dare to move.
The woman remained motionless, as if she was listening to the sound. After waiting for a while, but finding nothing, she began to cry softly again.
